verdict.rationale: The only team-level administrative control in the evidence is a security-doc fragment saying something 'controls which destinations team computers can reach,' a thin hint at an org network/data policy. Approval rules and Auto Review are per-user action gating, and Team Bots channel invites concern bots, not workspace member administration, so neither is credited. missing for 10: documented member invite/remove/role management, org-wide permission controls, explicit data retention/sharing policies for the workspace, an admin console description, and independent corroboration.
